_comment: Sample to merge into ~/.claude/settings.json to enable the Cognee graph-memory harness (v0.3.0 architecture). Merge manually with your existing settings.json. See docs/HARNESS_GUIDE.md for the meaning of each value.

permissions._comment_permissions: Auto-allow the main Cognee MCP tools so you are not prompted on every call.

_comment_v030_arch: v0.3.0 architecture: hooks above only append to the queue (~/.claude/cognee_pending_remembers.jsonl). The queue is drained by the cognee-queue-flush skill running inside the same Claude Code session, scheduled via /loop or CronCreate. This avoids the Ladybug DB lock contention error (Could not set lock on file) because no new cognee-mcp process is spawned.
_comment_queue_flush_setup: After installing this harness, run /loop 5m cognee-queue-flush inside Claude Code, or use CronCreate to schedule periodic runs. See harness/skills/cognee-queue-flush/SKILL.md for details.
_comment_v022_legacy_removed: The old cognee_remember_flusher.py hook has been removed in v0.3.0. Do NOT install or run it: it spawns a new cognee-mcp process and triggers the Ladybug DB lock contention error. Use the cognee-queue-flush skill instead.
